title: Advance Guided Journeys only after the current destination has actually settled

scope.subject: Reuse pinned-MIT TourPlayer arrival-before-dwell semantics and existing camera-controls settlement so Journey auto-advance never starts from an intermediate Approach/System frame

research_summary: Personal Universe already has a deliberately small Journey orchestrator over the shared UniverseNavigationDestination model. Its auto-advance effect currently starts a 6.5s dwell as soon as React phase becomes system/approach/orbit/surface and navigationStatus is not traveling, which is not equivalent to physical camera arrival. Pinned MIT YEIS TourPlayer explicitly keeps a flying/dwell distinction and only advances after narration is done, camera autopilot has actually arrived, and dwell has elapsed. Reuse that semantic primitive without porting the legacy TourPlayer UI/state machine: extend the existing camera-controls settled signal to System/Surface, track the currently settled product phase in UniverseApp, clear it on each destination change, and start Journey dwell only when the current phase is genuinely settled. Reduced-motion remains manual. Search/Places/Canvas/deep-link interruption continues through the same destination executor.

sources.finding: Pinned MIT TourPlayer models flying versus dwell and advances only when narration is complete, camera autopilot has arrived, and dwell has elapsed; it also treats competing camera navigation as interruption.
Pinned MIT TourPanel exposes Prev, Next, Pause and Stop independently of navigation internals, supporting Personal Universe's existing lightweight controls without copying the legacy UI.

The already-installed camera-controls API exposes current versus end position/target values, which Personal Universe now uses for real settled acceptance rather than merely observing a commanded destination.
Existing React state/effect primitives are sufficient to gate a single dwell timer on current settled phase; a second workflow/state-machine runtime is unnecessary.
XState remains a mature state-machine/actor option, but importing it for the small Journey phase/settled/dwell surface would duplicate orchestration authority already held by UniverseApp.

search_ladder.conclusion: Reuse pinned MIT YEIS TourPlayer's arrival-before-dwell and interruption semantics, while retaining Personal Universe's own small product UI and shared destination model.
XState could model the sequence but would add an unnecessary second orchestration runtime for a Journey state already represented by a few React fields.
Reuse the existing camera-controls instance and its true current-position settlement as the product-world arrival authority.
Use existing React state/effects for a single settled-phase latch and cancellable dwell timer; no new tour component or timer framework is needed.

candidates.name: Pinned MIT YEIS TourPlayer arrival-before-dwell semantics
candidates.reason: Its sequencing and interruption semantics are the right product primitive, but Personal Universe intentionally does not need narration/cues/time overrides or the legacy TourPanel DOM implementation.

candidates.name: Existing camera-controls true settled signal
candidates.reason: Already owns product-world camera motion and can expose System/Surface settled states with the same position/target acceptance used for Approach/Orbit.

candidates.name: XState Journey machine
candidates.reason: Adds a second actor/state-machine runtime and migration cost without replacing the destination executor, camera authority or existing Journey controls.

candidates.name: Existing React Journey orchestration
candidates.reason: A settled-phase latch and existing cancellable effect timer are sufficient to reproduce the useful TourPlayer sequencing semantics without another navigation authority.

decision.rationale: Keep the current shared destination model and lightweight Journey UI. Reuse pinned MIT TourPlayer's settled-before-dwell sequencing concept, existing camera-controls as the physical arrival signal, and React for the small latch/timer glue. System and Surface become real settled phases through the same camera authority. Reduced-motion remains manual and any competing destination navigation still interrupts the Journey.
decision.fallback: If Journey later gains narration, timed visual cues, time-rate overrides or many concurrent actors, reassess a larger TourPlayer/XState-style subsystem then; do not introduce it for the current destination-only journeys.
